audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing anywhere states that Fury of the North (P) grants immunity to slows, so Crippling Strike's slow — the tool that keeps her inside the Decimate blade — is blanked while Frost Armor holds. Nothing states that Permafrost (E) only stuns at max Frost stacks, built by Winter's Wrath (W).
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Frost Armor which grants Armor and Magic Resist and immunity to slows'; 'Sejuani freezes and stuns an enemy champion that has maximum Frost stacks.' These are the two facts that decide whether a Darius commit lands.
audit.corrected: Both stated, with Winter's Wrath at 9/8/7/6/5s and Permafrost's stack gate as the break-off cue. The mirror entry records the same slow-immunity finding from Sejuani's side.

edits.before: Your spike: Sejuani is a low-damage tank in lane — E her in, Q on the edge and stack Hemorrhage freely. Her Frost Armor passive means poke does little, so commit to full trades she can't win on damage.
edits.after: Your spike: Frost Armor makes her immune to the Crippling Strike slow, so she strolls out of your blade — Apprehend her in first, Q on the outer edge, and force the full trade her tank kit cannot win.

edits.before: Your spike holds — your R execute punishes her lack of sustain; even if she Glacial Prisons you, 5 stacks plus Noxian Guillotine outdamages anything her tank kit throws back.
edits.after: Your spike holds — Glacial Prison is 120s at rank 1, so eat the stun and cash out: 5 Hemorrhage stacks plus Noxian Guillotine's true damage beat anything her tank kit throws back.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 stay firmly Darius — E-Q-W full combos out-damage everything her tank kit answers with, and she can't sustain through 5 stacks. At 6 your R execute closes any trade she survives; play to shove and threaten kills whenever her E stun is down.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 stay firmly Darius — Permafrost only stuns at max Frost stacks and Winter's Wrath (9s at rank 1) is what fills them, so break off after her second mace arc. At 6 your R closes any trade she survives; shove and threaten kills while her stun is ungated.
